en: I bring news to the peace-loving{SAUT}citizens of Kamo City...
I have captured the dastardly thieves who{SAUT}threaten the harmony of our utopia!
However―there are yet more scoundrels{SAUT}lurking in the shadows of Kamo City!
I shall fight for you all...
So, I ask that you cooperate with me{SAUT}in the name of justice!
These rogues oppose our world's order―{SAUT}they are most assuredly evildoers!
Thus, as enemies of justice, each one{SAUT}shall be punished upon capture!
Huh!? Is this for effin' real!?
Come forth and witness their punishment{SAUT}exhibition at Kamoshida Square!
Isn't that right, citizens of Kamo City?
